name: Mox Icons – Icon Pack for Elementor
author: moxtheme

sections.description:
Mox Icons adds popular, high-quality icon libraries directly to Elementor’s native icon picker. No extra widget needed — just open any icon selector in Elementor and browse your new icons.

Included Libraries

  • Heroicons Outline — 324 clean stroke icons by Tailwind Labs (MIT License)
  • Heroicons Solid — 324 filled icons by Tailwind Labs (MIT License)
  • Material Design Icons — 7,000+ community icons by Pictogrammers (Apache 2.0)
  • Simple Line Icons — ~200 minimal icons (MIT License)

Features

  • ✅ Native Elementor icon picker integration
  • ✅ Toggle each library ON or OFF from Settings → Mox Icons
  • ✅ All assets bundled locally — no CDN, no external requests
  • ✅ Lightweight: only enabled libraries are loaded
  • ✅ Translation ready

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • Elementor 3.5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mox-icon folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Mox Icons to enable or disable individual icon packs
  4. Open Elementor editor — new icon tabs will appear in the icon picker
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor Free?

Yes, Mox Icons works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Will disabled libraries affect performance?

Yes. Disabled libraries are not enqueued at all, so they add zero weight to your pages.

Are the icons licensed for commercial use?

Yes. Heroicons is MIT licensed and Material Design Icons is Apache 2.0 licensed — both allow commercial use.
